transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I came in because I just can't seem to shake this heavy, hopeless feeling. It's... it's like everything I managed to build back up after my divorce has just completely collapsed, and I'm just sitting underneath it all. I just don't know what to do about it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this heavy and hopeless feeling?
It's been about a month now. It really started to just... hang over me when I was trying to sort through all the financial mess right after the divorce.
Have you ever gone through a period where you felt this down or hopeless at any other point in your life?

No... I don't think so. I mean, I've been stressed before, or had bad days, but... not like this. I've never felt this completely stuck and just empty before. This is really the first time it's ever been this bad.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?

Um... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed losing interest in things, exactly. I mean, I still care about the things I usually like doing. I just... I'm not really sure, I haven't been paying much attention to that lately with everything else going on.
How has your sleep been over the past month?

It hasn't been good. Lately, I either just lie awake staring at the ceiling, replaying all the bills and mistakes I've made at work... or I wake up way before dawn and feel like I never actually slept at all.
How have your energy levels been over the past month?

My energy has been really low. Getting through a normal workday just feels like... like dragging wet concrete. Even basic things, like taking a shower or just opening my laptop, it takes more energy than I seem to have right now. I'm just constantly exhausted.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past month?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any difference in my appetite. I mean, I haven't weighed myself recently or anything, but my clothes still fit exactly the same. So, no, no real changes there.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, focusing, or making decisions lately?

Yes, very much so. It's been really bad at work. I’ll look at a basic drainage calculation or a spreadsheet I’ve used for years, and... my mind just blanks. I end up just sitting there rereading the same numbers over and over, and I can't even bring myself to trust any decision I try to make.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling excessively guilty about things lately?

Yeah. I have. I just... I keep telling myself I'm a terrible engineer, and a failed wife. I really just feel like a burden to everyone right now. I end up sitting there replaying every little mistake in my head—every missed calculation, or even just a tense email—and it just feels like absolute proof that I ruin things.
With everything feeling so heavy and overwhelming, have you had any thoughts of wanting to end your life or that you'd be better off dead?

Yes. I have. I've just been thinking a lot lately that... that it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. It's been getting worse, and recently the thoughts got intense enough that I actually scared myself. That's what made me finally call the employee assistance program at work. I just didn't know what else to do.
